steps.factor_source: Siemens product carbon footprints: S7-1200 G2 CPU 12.4-14.4 kg cradle-to-gate; S7-1500 CPU 1517 69.3 kg (https://cache.industry.siemens.com/dl/files/794/109983794/att_1320577/v1/SIMATIC_S7-1500_CPU_6ES7517-3FQ10-0AB0_DI_FA_EPD00083.01.pdf; https://xcelerator.siemens.com/global/en/all-offerings/products/s/sigreen.html)
steps.factor_notes: per unit: electronic module proxy at the low end of Siemens' range (12.4 kg), est.
steps.method: est. CO2e avoided = weight x material factor (or a per-unit factor for electronics) x a 0.5 reuse credit. Cradle-to-gate manufacturing factors: steel 1.95 and cast iron 1.86 kg CO2e/kg (ICE / Ecoinvent); ~12-14 kg per PLC module (Siemens product footprints). The 0.5 credit is conservative: remanufacturing studies find 46-93% lower emissions. Shipping of the used part is not subtracted; weights are estimated shipping weights. Chemicals: no CO2 claim, disposal cost avoided instead (~$242 per 55-gal drum, a public fee schedule).
